_readme: Golden vectors for container -> Nix package-name resolution.
THE LANDMINE THIS FILE EXISTS TO DEFUSE:
nix/flake-modules/containers/redis.nix aliases `.#redis` to redis-8,
while this table maps a bare `redis` (no --version) to redis-7. Any
divergence silently changes which Redis is built and sends
`make redis-7-start` into a rebuild loop. There is a third, ALREADY
DRIFTED copy at src/lib/rust/nix-container-builder/src/config.rs
(missing airflow:3, kafka:4, spark:4, jupyterhub:5, odoo:15..18);
that file is owned by a later phase and is deliberately NOT a consumer
of this file yet.
THREE consumers, ONE table:
bash: bin/build/_common.sh's CONTAINER_REGISTRY assoc-array (hand-
maintained; bin/build/test-registry-parity.sh asserts it equals
this file, key for key, in both directions).
nix:  bin/nix/firestream/ci/profile.nix reads `entries` verbatim into
`ci.containerRegistry`, so ci-manifest.json carries it as data.
rust: firestream_ci::profile::Profile::resolve_package_name reads that
manifest. NO table is compiled into Rust.
`entries` keys are exactly the bash array's keys: `<container>:<version>`,
with an empty version meaning `the default for this container`.
`cases` are the resolution vectors: (container, version) -> package, plus
the unknown-container failure mode.

cases._why: THE LANDMINE. `.#redis` is redis-8 in the flake; the build path must still pick redis-7.
Bare odoo resolves to the UNSUFFIXED package name, unlike every other family.
UNKNOWN VERSION FALLS BACK TO THE FAMILY DEFAULT — it is not an error. resolve_package_name tries `<c>:<v>` then `<c>:`.
Unknown container: no `<c>:<v>` and no `<c>:` key. Bash logs and returns 1.
